Claim 8. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a lubricant comprising at least one selected from the group consisting of polyol ester and polyvinyl ether and a refrigerant comprising: from 1 to 99% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf); and from 1 to 99% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), wherein said composition __when tested according to ASHRAE test 97-2007__ exhibits a Hazen color of about 200 or less __when__ a sealed glass tube comprising the composition is welded closed and placed in an oven at __200°C__ for 14 days.

Claim 9. (Previously presented) The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from polyols having a neopentyl backbone.

Claim 10. (Previously presented) The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a polyol selected from the group consisting of neopentyl glycol, trimethylolpropane, pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol.

Claim 11. (Previously presented) The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 2 to 15 carbon atoms.

Claim 13. (Previously presented) The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms.

Claim 14. (Previously presented) The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the composition comprises from 10 to 50% by weight of the at least one polyol ester.
